dataset_policy: Only the existing 307 pure-training founders; augmentation is not independent evidence
decoder_features: The same stabilized 14 classifier/frequency fractions; reference preprocessing is never refitted
donor_selection: Uniform fine population, then uniform donor within source; training donors only
coverage_repair: Add training-only donor-safe plans for undercovered strata before extracting genotypes; never use validation errors
truth: Exact physical-base-pair fractions from saved half-open segments across both chromosome copies
simulation: Whole-parent F1 copies; otherwise shuffled 10-Mb source tiles from actual phased founder haplotypes. Complementary founder copies preserve diploid GT wherever both chromosomes use the same donor. Not Ped-sim/meiosis certification.
